scenario.task:
I want to upgrade my mobile plan but I have a strict budget of $60 per month

User Guide: The user wants to upgrade but mentions their $60 budget. They will verify their identity, ask for options under $60, select one, and confirm If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
